set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Expected validation data does not inherit Throwable merely to be returned in Either.
- Rank mismatch, invalid permutation, duplicate axis, invalid narrow, and wrong-rank transpose have semantically accurate error types.
- Checked constructors and refinements return pure error values.
- Throwing convenience APIs use documented typed exceptions or explicit unsafe names.
- No duplicate permutation or rank failure is reported as an unrelated InvalidAxis.
- Failure documentation and JVM or Scala.js tests cover both checked and throwing surfaces.
set.title: Unify checked errors and throwing convenience failures
